name: GitHub Copilot
note: Quota only — Copilot's sessions are read through the vscode harness. The token comes from `gh auth token` rather than an environment variable, because an app launched from Finder inherits no shell. Windows without has_quota are skipped: a free plan lists a premium tier it does not have. The endpoint is GitHub's own internal one — `copilot_internal/user` — and is published nowhere; checked 2026-09-22. Nothing here can be compared against a reference, so the fixture is the whole of the check. A window the plan reports as `unlimited` is not charted: a meter that can never move says a quota exists and that none of it has been spent, and both are false for an allowance with no cap — the same reason a balance draws its figure and no bar. Added 2026-09-24 after reading ClaudeBar's Copilot probe, which reports such a window as unlimited rather than as a percentage.

compatibility.note: Quota endpoint is runtime-validated; sessions belong to the VS Code harness.
